projects/hydration-1.21.1-neoforge/src/m.comparison: Same-scale 1x and 8x: bowl establishes dark cavity, bucket the upper rim and lower taper, oak planks warm neighboring timber tones; cup adds carved grain and a loop handle.

findings.silhouette: Wide elliptical mouth and slightly tapered upright wooden body with a right-side loop and open gap.
findings.cluster_structure: Light connected lip arc, separate dark cavity cluster and interrupted vertical brown wall clusters.
findings.micro_contrast: Small ochre patches alternate with deeper grain grooves without dissolving the wall into noise.
findings.light_and_volume: Top-left lip catches light; recessed interior and right-facing wall turn into darker brown; underside is shaded.
findings.material_continuity: Warm tan wood runs from rim through front grain; handle continues the timber palette at lower brightness.
findings.edge_variation: Stepped rim narrows toward foot, while handle has deliberate negative-space cutout.
findings.variant_identity: Tall open mug and loop handle distinguish it from closed leather and ceramic containers.
findings.vanilla_comparison: Bucket rim and bowl opening establish recess depth; oak plank shades calibrate restrained grain detail.
findings.construction: Thick carved lip surrounds an open cavity; loop meets wall near lip and lower body.
findings.surface_turn: Lighter front wall turns into darker side panel below handle and dark tapered lower lip.
findings.material_specific_shading: Soft grain changes and interrupted warm strokes differ from hard copper glints and matte clay.

projects/hydration-1.21.1-neoforge/src/m.comparison: Same-scale 1x and 8x: bundle supplies gathered fabric and accent bands, leather warm folds, bottle closure proportions; bag has an asymmetrical sloping shoulder and stitched gusset.

findings.silhouette: Sloping soft-sided leather pouch widens to lower left with raised narrow stopper at upper right.
findings.cluster_structure: Broad warm shoulder folds meet smaller tapered amber clusters; darker right gusset remains separate.
findings.micro_contrast: Short light stitches punctuate brown gusset at intervals; stopper has separate cork tones.
findings.light_and_volume: Soft ochre upper-left highlight breaks around fold and transitions into shaded lower and right panels.
findings.material_continuity: Leather shades connect across bag body while cork and seam accents remain localized to construction.
findings.edge_variation: Diagonal shoulder changes widths and the bottom settles into an irregular rounded pouch.
findings.variant_identity: Offset neck, slumped body and stitched seam distinguish it from rigid copper and handled clay.
findings.vanilla_comparison: Bundle shoulder and leather fold relationships are echoed; bottle keeps closure legible at native size.
findings.construction: Tied neck below small stopper and sewn side gusset explain how pouch is sealed and joined.
findings.surface_turn: Inflated broad panel narrows into right edge seam and turns into dark bottom.
findings.material_specific_shading: Soft worn folds and short seam details replace a metal-like continuous bright reflection.

projects/hydration-1.21.1-neoforge/src/m.comparison: Same-scale 1x and 8x: flower pot supplies dark terracotta opening and thick rim, brick fired-clay palette, bottle narrow neck; jug adds an asymmetric belly and visible handle.

findings.silhouette: Flared neck above a rounded belly and raised right ear handle makes jug recognizable.
findings.cluster_structure: Compact rim cluster caps neck; adjacent clay tones form broad left shoulder and irregular belly planes.
findings.micro_contrast: Warm reddish patches on lower belly suggest uneven fired clay without random speckles.
findings.light_and_volume: Upper-left shoulder is light; neck under rim, right belly and underside progressively darker.
findings.material_continuity: Rim, neck, handle and belly remain within coherent muted terracotta ramp.
findings.edge_variation: Neck tapers into stepped shoulder and handle retains narrow transparent opening separate from body.
findings.variant_identity: Open flared lip, ceramic shoulder and loop handle separate jug from sealed canteen and soft bag.
findings.vanilla_comparison: Flower pot supplies recessed rim contrast; brick supplies local clay shade changes rather than metallic streaks.
findings.construction: Thick lip surrounds dark mouth; neck, attached handle, rounded body and shaded foot form vessel.
findings.surface_turn: Matte adjoining belly clusters expand below shoulder and narrow into shaded right curve and foot.
findings.material_specific_shading: Muted clay hues and broad uneven matte patches suggest kiln-fired ceramic without polished specular band.

projects/hydration-1.21.1-neoforge/src/m.comparison: Same-scale 1x and 8x: copper ingot has salmon highlight and rich reddish shadows; honey bottle closure proportions; oxidized copper green hue relationships. Patina confined to lower joint instead of floating spot.

findings.silhouette: Squat rigid flask with offset brass-colored cap, defined shoulders and flatter foot than clay jug.
findings.cluster_structure: Compact bright salmon reflection across left shoulder transitions through copper midtones into darker right rim and joined lower edge.
findings.micro_contrast: Small warm reflective clusters break at shoulder and a green ramp traces the lower joint.
findings.light_and_volume: Reflective left/front metal catches top-left light with sharper value break while outer right seam is shaded.
findings.material_continuity: Copper hues continue across pressed body; brass and green oxidation occur at closure and damp bottom seam.
findings.edge_variation: Stepped shoulder rises to cap, right side comparatively straight, body closes with low flat seam.
findings.variant_identity: Low rigid flask, brass stopper and bottom oxidation differentiate from soft pouch and handled earthenware.
findings.vanilla_comparison: Copper ingot calibrates warm reflection; oxidized copper calibrates subdued green on lower joint.
findings.construction: Cap has distinct top and band, neck joins broad shoulders, lower folded seam has dark border.
findings.surface_turn: Brighter left shoulder and central face turn into narrow shaded right edge and flatter lower seam.
findings.material_specific_shading: Copper uses relatively crisp peach reflection and localized green patina; clay uses muted matte tones.

projects/hydration-1.21.1-neoforge/src/m.comparison: Same-scale 1x and 8x: copper ingot calibrates reddish reflection, spyglass the two-metal collar and dark aperture, oxidized copper the green joint accents. Bent pipe has two open connector ends.

findings.silhouette: Angular bent tube with two brass-rimmed open ports on left and continuous vertical leg on right.
findings.cluster_structure: Bright copper strips follow upper and lower runs into elbow; collars have separate dark bore and rim clusters.
findings.micro_contrast: Small warm collar highlights frame dark port centers; muted green confined to lower connection.
findings.light_and_volume: Top-left tube surfaces and collar rims brighter than outer right edge, underside and inner bend.
findings.material_continuity: Continuous copper ramp along main bend; brass rims and oxidation appear at functional joints.
findings.edge_variation: Squared collar edges interrupt stepped bend; central notch remains transparent for identifiable tube shape.
findings.variant_identity: Two visible apertures and bent tubing distinguish mechanical part from closed copper canteen.
findings.vanilla_comparison: Spyglass rim/bore contrast provides connector depth; copper ingot and oxidized copper support materials.
findings.functional_material_cues: Both connector mouths have dark recessed opening surrounded by lighter collar; oxidation sits along lower tube joint.

projects/hydration-1.21.1-neoforge/src/m.comparison: Same-scale 1x and 8x: charcoal has angular dark clusters, bundle cloth folds and dark opening, white wool soft neighboring shades; open filter cartridge rather than closed pot.

findings.silhouette: Upright wrapped filter cartridge with wide open upper rim and narrower banded base.
findings.cluster_structure: Uneven gray-black charcoal clusters fill mouth, bordered by cream cloth lip and broader warm cloth planes.
findings.micro_contrast: Neighboring charcoal chips use dark gray value changes; tan patches and horizontal binding add textile detail.
findings.light_and_volume: Light rim and left cloth face contrast with recessed charcoal interior and dark right and bottom surfaces.
findings.material_continuity: Cloth wrap uses muted warm ramp; charcoal stays dark and mineral-like inside the open mouth.
findings.edge_variation: Rounded rim has uneven stepped corners and lower wrap narrows toward its binding.
findings.variant_identity: Visible charcoal media and layered cloth bindings distinguish filter from fluid containers and metal fittings.
findings.vanilla_comparison: Charcoal clusters at mouth darker and more angular than cloth; bundle and wool establish soft wrapping cues.
findings.functional_material_cues: Exposed charcoal bed readable above folded cloth wrap and horizontal binding band, explaining filtration medium.

projects/hydration-1.21.1-neoforge/src/m.comparison: Actual first 16x16 frame of official grayscale animated water_still atlas inspected at 1x and 8x; revised candidate reviewed in 3x3 tiling. Fixed blue surface uses lower contrast and broader connected ripples because it is an opaque tank surface, not tinted animated world fluid.

findings.silhouette: Full 16x16 opaque liquid surface fills interior model face without introducing a hard border.
findings.cluster_structure: Connected cool patches of varying widths form elongated ripple groups with transitional midtones.
findings.micro_contrast: Adjacent blues remain close in value so lighter ripple centers do not read as isolated bright marks.
findings.light_and_volume: Subdued horizontal ripple highlights suggest level liquid surface rather than raised solid or vertically shaded material.
findings.material_continuity: Cool blue shades remain coherent across tile edges and do not introduce foreign speckles.
findings.edge_variation: Ripple boundaries widen and narrow unevenly; tile edges use neighboring midtones rather than a directional frame.
findings.variant_identity: Water is distinct from surrounding wood and fired-clay walls and used on existing filled tank states.
findings.vanilla_comparison: Official water_still frame has irregular connected bright and gray patches; static surface adapts that ripple structure to muted blue.
findings.functional_material_cues: Revised 3x3 preview retains low-contrast ripple groups without an obvious dark tile boundary; deliberately static and opaque.

review_scope: Private static same-scale native/nearest-neighbor comparison with PNGs from official 1.21.1 client (verified SHA-1 30c73b1c5da787909b2f73340419fdf13b9def88), including first water frame and final 3x3 tile. No in-game render claim.
